answer: Assembling that for 48 aliases means 48 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Because each onyx escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the yarrow ledger records every share and the gale audit shows the split. A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 27 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
